techniques.name: Clone Technique
techniques.mechanic: Spawns 3 illusory copies of you (no hitbox) that run off in different directions for 100 ticks; each mob has a 60% chance to switch target to a copy
techniques.counters: sensing, Byakugan and Sharingan see through them; a hit pops a copy

techniques.name: Transformation
techniques.mechanic: Your render becomes a chosen resident's look (or an object's: a log, a crate) until you attack or take damage; mobs lose their target; residents do not recognize you
techniques.counters: sensing; a touch; dogs smell you

techniques.name: Substitution
techniques.mechanic: Dodge as a hit lands, with 10 chakra: blink back 5 blocks with 12 i-frames, a log entity takes the blow. Once per 20 s
techniques.counters: a second attack right after; sensing follows the blink

techniques.name: Release
techniques.mechanic: Breaks a genjutsu on yourself (weave Ram while caught); costs the illusion's strength in chakra

techniques.name: Rope Escape
techniques.mechanic: Passive: mashing movement escapes wire, rope and webs 40% faster

techniques.name: Field First Aid
techniques.mechanic: Hold use on a downed or hurt ally for 60 ticks: heals 4 HP and stops bleeding (no chakra)

techniques.name: Hiding in Camouflage
techniques.mechanic: Standing still you take on the colour of the block behind you: hidden until you move faster than a walk or attack
techniques.counters: sensing; Byakugan; dogs; stepping within 3 blocks

techniques.name: Body Flicker
techniques.mechanic: A burst of speed: 8 blocks in 4 ticks in the facing direction, with a leaf swirl; can open a dash attack

techniques.name: Shadow Clone
techniques.mechanic: Two to four real clone entities with basic combat AI and your taijutsu chain; each takes an equal share of your current chakra and pops after one hit

techniques.name: Multi Shadow Clone
techniques.mechanic: Up to twelve shadow clones (cap by chakra); they swarm a target or carry your signs for a squad combo

techniques.name: Clone Great Explosion
techniques.mechanic: A shadow clone that explodes when it grabs or is hit: 3-block blast
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Spiralling Sphere
techniques.mechanic: No signs: hold use for 20 ticks to form a sphere of spinning chakra in your hand, then strike: a drilling hit that launches the target 10 blocks
techniques.counters: it is melee: parry the arm, keep range, substitute

techniques.name: Great Spiralling Sphere
techniques.mechanic: A sphere as big as a barrel (needs a shadow clone to help shape it, 30 ticks): 4-block blast on contact
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Chakra Threads
techniques.mechanic: Invisible threads from the fingertips (12 blocks): pull a light enemy or an item, or steer a thrown weapon after release
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles
